name: 翻译与本地化助手
examples_zh: 把这份合同翻译成英文并保留原有格式
先建术语表，再统一翻译这批产品文档
把这段落地页文案本地化给英国用户
examples_en: Translate this contract into English and keep the formatting
Build a glossary and translate these product docs consistently
Localize this landing page copy for a UK audience
description_zh: 面向文档的中英互译与本地化：先建术语表保证全文一致，翻译时保留原文结构与格式，再做本地化适配（度量衡、日期格式、称谓、文化习惯），交付译文与术语表并附质量自检。不承接公证翻译、不承诺出版级署名。
description_en: Professional Chinese-English document translation and localization that builds a terminology glossary first for consistency, preserves source structure and formatting, then adapts units, dates, forms of address and cultural conventions. Deliver translation, glossary and a quality self-check. Not certified translation, no publication-grade guarantee.
